assets.name: enemy-drek
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual full-body enemy sprite for the existing mobile game Manolo el Mazmorrero. Bold hand-inked distressed editorial screenprint, very heavy black contours, chunky expressive comic silhouettes, stippled print grain, flat limited electric yellow, hot magenta, warm ivory and charcoal inks. Not pixel art, not realistic, not 3D, not smooth gradients. One single creature only, centered full body in square frame occupying 88% height, safe margins 6%, all extremities visible, feet near bottom. Slight elevated three-quarter game view, oriented toward viewer and slightly right. True transparent alpha background, including gaps between limbs; no backdrop, checkerboard, ground, cast shadow, glow outside silhouette, sticker border, words, labels or watermark. Menacing but darkly funny. Creature must be legible at 65–125 pixels tall. Subject: Drek, a fictional small demonic goblin-like monster with squat baby-like proportions but clearly inhuman, wrinkled ash-grey skin represented with charcoal/ivory halftone, oversized toothed mouth, sharp clawed hands and feet, tiny ragged magenta loincloth. Hunched aggressive scrambling pose, hugely exaggerated toothy grin, wild yellow eyes. No gore. Not a human baby, not a goblin with green skin. Compact round silhouette.

assets.name: room-railway
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production arena background for existing mobile game Manolo el Mazmorrero. Gritty hand-inked editorial screenprint, black heavy contours, distressed grain, flat ink shapes, warm ivory highlights, no photorealism, no pixel art, no 3D. Canvas aspect 8:7. Near top-down slightly elevated 3/4 camera looking at a rectangular arena. Image filled edge-to-edge. Back wall confined to top 14%, side walls outermost 5%, bottom lip bottom 6%. Entire area x=7%..93% y=16%..91% must be fully walkable OPEN low-contrast dark ground. NO freestanding obstacles, pillars, rails, pitfalls, props, fire, targets or hazards on playing floor. All decoration confined to perimeter. Not a perspective horizon scene. No people, monsters, characters, text, letters, numbers, interface, watermarks. Theme LA MARAÑA DE HIERRO: sinister underground metro maintenance platform. Upper edge has black tunnel mouth, old iron overhead cables, vintage empty train carriage windows, small unlettered departure boards. Thin track hints only on outer borders beyond playing zone, no tracks crossing center. Side borders corroded steel and riveted bumpers. Broad dark desaturated blue-charcoal floor made of very faint industrial steel panels. Sparse dusty teal and warm ivory border architecture, electric yellow caution strips only at edges and tiny magenta signal lamps. Open clear central floor, dark subdued #20282e. This must look different from a slaughterhouse or television stage.
